propositions: On the agentic path, tool-result message history is re-sent uncached every turn, causing input cost to grow O(N^2) in the number of turns and remaining invisible to rebar's telemetry because only the system block hits cache

cache_settings_for sets only two of four available breakpoints (anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions) and explicitly does not touch anthropic_cache_messages or anthropic_cache
Anthropic and Bedrock require different cache configuration keys: Anthropic needs anthropic_cache=True while Bedrock needs bedrock_cache_messages=True, as Bedrock rejects top-level cache_control
Single-turn execution paths must remain byte-identical after the fix to avoid regression

Multi-turn agentic runs show 7-9x improvement in cache efficiency when message-tail caching is enabled, reducing uncached input tokens from ~97k to ~10 and increasing cache-read tokens from flat 1,240 to monotonically growing attribution
